input.rationale: No non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use restriction binds Client anywhere in the Agreement, so the preferred position is met. Section 2(a) goes further in our favour by expressly confirming Client is free to acquire, develop or license competing software and services (subject only to not infringing TrueLink's IP and to the Section 10 confidentiality obligations). The only Client covenants (Section 8) concern legal compliance, access control, no misrepresentation of underwriting decisions and no spamming — none restrict the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. The single reference to a "Non-Competition Agreement" in Section 8(d) operates as a limitation on TrueLink's licence to use Credit Data, i.e. it restricts the Vendor and benefits us; the licence-grant wording tying Interface use to Client's consumer-finance origination business is a scope-of-licence limit, not a restraint on Client's business, and is noted only for completeness.
